OutdatedState.text:
You are running an outdated version of Seiun Engine ({current}).
Latest version: {latest}

Press ENTER / A to open the download page.
Press ESCAPE / B to continue anyway.

Thank you for using the Engine!
ChartingState.text:
W/S or Mouse Wheel - Adjust Conductor's strum time

A/D - Jump to Previous/Next Section

Left Arrow/Right Arrow - Change Snap

Up Arrow/Down Arrow - Adjust Conductor's Strum Time with Snap

[ / ] - Change Playback Rate (Hold Shift for faster adjustment)

ALT + [ / ] - Reset Playback Rate

Hold Shift for 4x Speed Movement

Hold Control and click a note arrow to select it

Z/X - Zoom In/Out

Esc - Test Chart in Editor

Enter - Play Chart

Q/E - Decrease/Increase Note Sustain Length

Spacebar - Stop/Resume Song
FreeplayState.leText: Press SPACE to listen to the Song / Press CTRL to open the Gameplay Changers Menu / Press RESET to Reset your Score and Accuracy. / Press M to switch the Multi-file Chart mode.
FreeplayState.leText.NOTRELOAD_ALL: Press CTRL to open the Gameplay Changers Menu / Press RESET to Reset your Score and Accuracy. / Press M to switch the Multi-file Chart mode.
FreeplayState.leText.android: Press X to listen to the Song / Press C to open the Gameplay Changers Menu / Press Y to Reset your Score and Accuracy. / Press D to switch the Multi-file Chart mode.
FreeplayState.leText.NOTRELOAD_ALL.andro: Press C to open the Gameplay Changers Menu / Press Y to Reset your Score and Accuracy. / Press D to switch the Multi-file Chart mode.
